target.statement: MSE of 0.021 for PadInv on FFHQ face inversion (Table 1, 'Ours' row, Face MSE column)

compute.basis: Training a StyleGAN inversion encoder on 65k FFHQ images requires GPU compute; even with a mid-range GPU, training takes ~2 days, and CPU-only would be infeasible.

blockers: Training the encoder requires a GPU with sufficient VRAM (≥11GB) and takes ~2 days on a mid-range GPU.
The official code repository (Hammer) is a general toolkit; the specific PadInv implementation may not be directly provided, requiring significant adaptation.
Pre-trained StyleGAN generators for FFHQ are needed but not explicitly linked in the paper.
title: High-fidelity GAN Inversion with Padding Space
